lixpiValue: user-selected from three fixed sizes plus auto
summary: Selects output pixel dimensions. GPT Image 2 accepts arbitrary dimensions within its documented edge, divisibility, ratio, and total-pixel limits; Lixpi exposes reviewed presets plus auto so requests remain predictable across generation and editing paths.
combines: Each edge must be at most 3840 pixels and divisible by 16.
Aspect ratio must be no wider or taller than 3:1.
Total pixels must be between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

usage.code: size is read from state.imageSize, falls back to 'auto', and is sent through Responses image tools, images.generate, and images.edit
usage.what: Controls output pixel dimensions. The synchronized labels present provider sizes as their corresponding aspect ratios.

note: UI presets: auto, 1024x1024, 1536x1024, 1024x1536. The provider also accepts arbitrary valid dimensions, but freeform sizing is not part of the approved UI control.
